A surface $f(x,y)$ has no single slope &.zh: 曲面 $f(x,y)$ 并没有单一的斜率 — 它在每个方向上的倾斜都不同。偏导数的做法是固定住一个变量，从而提出那个普通的、一维的问题。在地图上移动该点，观察两个切片——每个都有自己的切线——以及把它们汇总起来的梯度箭头。
A surface $f(x,y)$ has no single slope &.src:
A surface $f(x,y)$ has no single slope — it tilts differently in every
      direction. A partial derivative fixes that by holding one variable still and
      asking the ordinary one-dimensional question. Move the point on the map and
      watch two slices, each with its own tangent, and the gradient arrow that
      collects them.

Freeze one axis, take a normal derivativ.zh: 冻结一根轴，求一个普通的导数
Freeze one axis, take a normal derivativ.src: Freeze one axis, take a normal derivative

To measure $\\partial f / \\partial x$ a.zh: 要测量点 $(x_0, y_0)$ 处的 $\partial f / \partial x$，就固定 $y = y_0$。剩下的是仅关于 $x$ 的一条曲线，而它普通的斜率@@T0@@就是@@T1@@偏导数。把两者角色互换便得到 $\partial f / \partial y$：
To measure $\\partial f / \\partial x$ a.src: To measure $\partial f / \partial x$ at a point $(x_0, y_0)$, pin $y = y_0$. What remains is a curve in $x$ alone, and its ordinary slope is the partial derivative. Swap the roles for $\partial f / \partial y$:

Stack the two partials into a vector and.zh: 把两个偏导数堆成一个向量，就得到梯度 $\nabla f = \big(\partial f/\partial x,\; \partial f/\partial y\big)$。它指向最陡上升的方向，且垂直于等高线 — 这是优化中最重要的单一对象。
Stack the two partials into a vector and.src:
Stack the two partials into a vector and you have the gradient
      $\nabla f = \big(\partial f/\partial x,\; \partial f/\partial y\big)$. It points
      in the direction of steepest ascent, perpendicular to the contour lines —
      the single most important object in optimization.

One point, two slices, one gradient.zh: 一个点、两个切片、一个梯度
One point, two slices, one gradient.src: One point, two slices, one gradient

The map is a filled contour plot of $f(x.zh: 这张地图是 $f(x,y)$ 的填色等高线图：蓝色表示低，橙色表示高。@@T0@@在地图上点击或拖动@@T1@@（或使用滑块）来移动该点。虚线就是那两个切片；每个切片都在下方连同其切线一起重绘，切线的斜率即为对应的偏导数。绿色箭头是 $\nabla f$ — 注意它总是指向上坡，横穿等高线。
The map is a filled contour plot of $f(x.src: The map is a filled contour plot of $f(x,y)$: blue is low, orange is high. Click or drag on the map (or use the sliders) to move the point. The dashed lines are the two slices; each slice is redrawn below with its tangent, whose slope is the corresponding partial derivative. The green arrow is $\nabla f$ — notice it always points uphill, across the contours.

Contour map of $f(x,y)$. Orange dashed l.zh: $f(x,y)$ 的等高线图。橙色虚线 $y=y_0$ 生成左侧切片；蓝色虚线 $x=x_0$ 生成右侧切片。绿色箭头是梯度 $\nabla f(x_0,y_0)$。

Slice $g(x)=f(x,\\,y_0)$ &mdash; hold $y.zh: 切片 $g(x)=f(x,\,y_0)$ — 固定 $y$。切线斜率 $=\partial f/\partial x$。
Slice $g(x)=f(x,\\,y_0)$ &mdash; hold $y.src: Slice $g(x)=f(x,\,y_0)$ — hold $y$ fixed. Tangent slope $=\partial f/\partial x$.

Slice $g(y)=f(x_0,\\,y)$ &mdash; hold $x.zh: 切片 $g(y)=f(x_0,\,y)$ — 固定 $x$。切线斜率 $=\partial f/\partial y$。
Slice $g(y)=f(x_0,\\,y)$ &mdash; hold $x.src: Slice $g(y)=f(x_0,\,y)$ — hold $x$ fixed. Tangent slope $=\partial f/\partial y$.

@@T0@@Try the saddle.@@T1@@ Sit at the o.zh: @@T0@@试试鞍形。@@T1@@ 停在原点：两个偏导数都是 $0$，故 $\nabla f = 0$ — 这是一个临界点。但左侧切片向上@@T2@@弯@@T3@@，右侧切片向下@@T4@@弯@@T5@@。梯度为零并不意味着极小值；这里是鞍点。现在移离中心，观察绿色箭头如何骤然指向正上坡方向。
@@T0@@Try the saddle.@@T1@@ Sit at the o.src: Try the saddle. Sit at the origin: both partials are $0$, so $\nabla f = 0$ — a critical point. Yet the left slice curves up and the right slice curves down. Zero gradient does not mean a minimum; here it is a saddle. Now step off-centre and watch the green arrow snap to point straight uphill.

The two partials are the components of o.zh:
这两个偏导数是同一个向量的两个分量，而该向量承担着一项几何职责。沿任意单位方向 $u$，变化率就是方向导数 $
abla f \cdot u$。由 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式，当 $u$ 与 $
abla f$ 对齐时该点积最大 — 所以梯度指向最陡上升方向，而 $-
abla f$ 才是梯度下降真正迈步的方向。
The two partials are the components of o.src:
The two partials are the components of one vector, and that vector has a
      geometric job. Along any unit direction $u$, the rate of change is the
      directional derivative $\nabla f \cdot u$. By Cauchy–Schwarz this dot
      product is largest when $u$ aligns with $\nabla f$ — so the gradient
      points in the direction of steepest ascent, and $-\nabla f$ is the direction
      gradient descent actually steps.

@@T0@@Perpendicular to contours.@@T1@@ M.zh: @@T0@@垂直于等高线。@@T1@@ 沿着@@T2@@等高线@@T3@@移动会保持 $f$ 不变，故该方向的斜率为零；而梯度作为最陡方向，必然与之成直角。观察箭头 — 它从不沿颜色带延伸。
@@T0@@Perpendicular to contours.@@T1@@ M.src: Perpendicular to contours. Moving along a contour keeps $f$ constant, so that direction has zero slope; the gradient, being steepest, must be at right angles to it. Watch the arrow — it never runs along a colour band.

@@T0@@Every weight is an axis.@@T1@@ A n.zh: @@T0@@每个权重都是一根轴。@@T1@@ 网络的损失依赖于数百万个参数。它的梯度为每个权重各有一个偏导数，每个都是该权重专属的一维切片的斜率，而反向传播在一次反向遍历中把它们全部算出。
@@T0@@Every weight is an axis.@@T1@@ A n.src: Every weight is an axis. A network's loss depends on millions of parameters. Its gradient has one partial per weight, each the slope of a private one-dimensional slice, and backprop computes them all in a single backward pass.

@@T0@@Flat spots are ambiguous.@@T1@@ $\.zh: @@T0@@平坦之处含义模糊。@@T1@@ $\nabla f = 0$ 既标志着极小值、极大值，@@T2@@也@@T3@@标志着鞍点。切片的曲率 — 即 Hessian — 才能把它们区分开。
@@T0@@Flat spots are ambiguous.@@T1@@ $\.src: Flat spots are ambiguous. $\nabla f = 0$ marks minima, maxima, and saddles alike. The curvature of the slices — the Hessian — tells them apart.

@@T0@@Next up:@@T1@@ when the output is.zh: @@T0@@下一节：@@T1@@当输出也是一个向量时，每个输出都有自己的梯度。把它们按行堆叠，就得到 Jacobian — 一整个由偏导数构成的矩阵，它把映射线性化。那就是最后一篇讲解，@@T2@@《Jacobian 是局部扭曲》@@T3@@。
@@T0@@Next up:@@T1@@ when the output is.src: Next up: when the output is also a vector, each output has its own gradient. Stack them as rows and you get the Jacobian — a whole matrix of partials that linearizes a map. That is the final explainer, The Jacobian is a Local Warp.

meta.title: 偏导数就是切片
meta.tagline: 冻结一个变量，求一个普通导数——梯度不过是把各条斜率汇总起来
meta.summary: 曲面在每个方向上的倾斜都不同，因此没有单一斜率。在 f(x,y) 的填色等高线图上移动一个点，观察两个一维切片出现：一个固定 y，一个固定 x，各自带有一条切线，其斜率便是相应的偏导数。绿色梯度箭头把两个偏导数堆叠起来，始终指向上坡且垂直于等高线。碗形、鞍形与波纹三个示例让临界点、最陡上升以及零梯度的含义都变得具体。
highlights: 在碗形、鞍形或波纹的填色等高线图上拖动一个点，观察两条切片曲线实时更新。
每个切片都画出自己的切线，其斜率正是固定住一个变量后所得的偏导数。
梯度箭头把两个偏导数汇总起来，始终指向上坡，并与等高线带成直角。
把 ∂f/∂x、∂f/∂y、梯度范数与高度读作四个相互关联的数字。
理解为何零梯度可能是极小值、极大值或鞍点——以及为何 -grad 才是下降所迈的方向。
